name: ripply transcriptional repressor 2

function.text: RIPPLY2 is the approved symbol for ripply transcriptional repressor 2. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in embryonic pattern specification; negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include spondylocostal dysostosis 6, autosomal recessive (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; Strong GenCC assertion, Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific review required.
